answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: each agent must lock scarce collateral before it can act, so spinning up a thousand fake identities means posting a thousand real bonds. The network stops being a free oasis of cheap signups — an identity now carries weight like seasoned timber, not froth. Honest agents accrue reputation, a pearl earned slowly through verified work, while any sybil that misbehaves forfeits its stake on-ledger.
